p.docTitle:
EAER Ordinance
on the Declaration for Timber and Timber Products

preamble.p:
The Federal Department of Economic Affairs Education and Research (EAER
The name of this administrative unit was amended in application of Art. 16 para. 3 of the Publications Ordinance of 17 Nov. 2004 (AS 2004 4937) on 1 Jan. 2013. The amendment has been made throughout the text.),

based on Articles 1 paragraph 2 and 2 paragraph 2 the Ordinance of 4 June 2010
SR 944.021 on the Declaration for Timber and Timber Products,

article.heading: Timber and timber products subject to declaration

content.p: The duty to declare applies to timber and timber products specified in the Annex.

article.heading: Reference system for the declaration of timber species

blockList.listIntroduction: The reference system for the declaration of the timber species comprises:

item.p:
the commercial timber list of the Swiss Timber Trade Centre
The list may be inspected under: www.konsum.admin.ch; and

Standard SN EN 13556:2003
The text of this standard can be consulted free of charge and obtained against payment from the Swiss Association for Standardization (SNV), Sulzerallee 70, 8404 Winterthur..

content.p: This Ordinance comes into force on 1 October 2010.

Annex
Revised in accordance with No I of the EAER Ordinance of 2 Dec. 2011 (AS 2011 6267), of 18 Oct. 2016 (AS 2016 3853) and of 26 Aug. 2022, in force since 1 Oct. 2022 (AS 2022 475).

level.heading: Timber and Timber Products subject to Declaration

td.p: Fuel wood, in logs, in billets, in twigs, in faggots or in similar forms:
Wood charcoal (including shell or nut charcoal), whether or not agglomerated
Wood in the rough, whether or not stripped of bark or sapwood, or roughly cut at two or four sides

Hoopwood, split poles, piles, pickets and stakes of wood, pointed but not sawn lengthwise, wooden sticks, roughly trimmed but not turned, bent or otherwise worked, suitable for the manufacture of walking sticks, umbrellas, tool handles and the like, chipwood, woodstrips, woodbands and the like
Railway or tramway sleepers of wood, and the like
Wood sawn or chipped lengthwise, sliced or peeled, whether or not planed, sanded or end-jointed, of a thickness exceeding 6mm.

Wood (including strips and friezes for parquet flooring, not assembled) continuously shaped (tongued, grooved, rebated, chamfered, V-jointed, beaded, moulded, rounded or the like) along any of its edges, ends or faces, whether or not planed, sanded or end-jointed
Wooden frames for paintings, photographs , mirrors or similar objects, made of solid wood
Casks, barrels, vats, tubs and other coopers’ products and parts thereof, made of solid wood

Posts and beams made of solid wood, with the exception of
Nos 4418.81– 4418.89
Seats with main components made of solid wood
other furniture with main components made of solid wood
